notes: Kira Debug Bridge-style telemetry transport: Roblox writes precise PlaceId, GameId, JobId and RenderStepped FPS to a Delta workspace status.json mailbox; Watchdog reads it through ADB shell cat with session/freshness validation. The telemetry script is embedded in the binary and automatically pushed to Delta Autoexecute for the selected VM. HTTP/adb-reverse telemetry has been removed; logcat/SurfaceFlinger remain fallbacks.
